title: sdks: unify auth/retries/streaming ergonomics + parity fixes (v1.52.0)
author: Maya Patel
description: Motivation: SDKs (python/ts/go) have drifted in how they handle auth, retry semantics, and streaming ergonomics. This PR unifies the behavior across SDKs, fixes several parity issues surfaced by integration tests, and includes coordinated version bumps to v1.52.0 for Python/TypeScript/Go. Changes are intentionally small in each repo but coordinated across packages. Checklist: - [x] Consolidate auth token refresh logic and add unified token provider interface - [x] Normalize retry/backoff config and default policies across SDKs - [x] Streaming: make client-side reconnect and backpressure semantics consistent and document ergonomic helpers - [x] Fix parity issues: method names, request/response schema differences, and example code in README - [x] Bump package versions to v1.52.0 and update changelogs - [x] Add cross-SDK integration tests and CI matrix entries Concurrent work: ENG-71922 tracks follow-ups (TLS session pinning, advanced backpressure modes). Breaking changes: none expected for typical consumers; there are some renamed internal helpers (not exported) and a slight change in default retry policy (more conservative). Migration notes: - No action required for most users. - If you relied on the old streaming reconnect behavior you may opt into legacy mode via the client option `streaming_legacy_mode=true` for one release. Implementation summary: - Python: introduced redwood.auth.TokenProvider, unified retry.RetryPolicy with exponential_jitter backoff, streaming client abstracts reconnect + resume tokens. - TypeScript: exported TokenProvider interface, added RetryPolicy type and defaultPolicy, streaming client exposes `onReconnect` hook and `createStreamController()` ergonomic helper. - Go: added token provider interface to auth pkg, retry package with Config struct and default values, streaming client exposes StreamController struct for easier flow control. Testing: unit tests for all SDKs, end-to-end cross-sdk integration tests added to the redwood/e2e matrix. CI: added separate jobs for python/ts/go SDKs in the matrix to ensure parity on common scenarios. See commits for granular changes.

release_notes: v1.52.0: SDKs - unified auth token provider and retry/backoff semantics; improved streaming ergonomics with StreamController helper; parity fixes across Python/TypeScript/Go; CI e2e parity tests added. No breaking changes for most users; streaming legacy mode flag available for compatibility.
notes_for_release_team: Coordinate staged SDK package publishes: publish python wheel and go module, then TS package. Update public docs site after packages available. Watch for increased downloads on new SDK docs page. Notify integrators about streaming_legacy_mode flag and default retry policy change.
backport_plan: No immediate backports. If customers report regression in retry aggressiveness as blocking, consider backport to latest v1.x maintenance branch with opt-in legacy policy.
test_plan: Unit tests added per SDK; end-to-end cross-SDK parity tests added to e2e matrix. QA to exercise streaming reconnect scenarios and token refresh under short-lived tokens.
notes: This PR was coordinated across multiple repos and required small, targeted changes per language to avoid large diffs. The e2e parity tests surfaced subtle differences in event ordering for streaming; fixes were included.
